segments.speaker: mother_skarrow
segments.text: Valley people. Say what you came to say, or go back down the hill.

segments.speaker: mother_skarrow
segments.text: You came back up the hill. Not many valley people do that twice.

segments.speaker: mother_skarrow
segments.text: Fed. For now. The little ones have stopped crying in the night. That is a sound I had forgotten.

segments.speaker: mother_skarrow
segments.text: With my grandson. Vorga thinks a bargain is a defeat. He took the angriest of our young and went east. He will be someone's problem.

segments.speaker: mother_skarrow
segments.text: Anything else, valley people? The fire is small, and I am old.

segments.speaker: mother_skarrow
segments.text: Go well. Walk loud on the path, so the archers know it is you.
